epic.title: In-App Messaging & Trade Chat
epic.description: Enable retail investors to discuss trade ideas, share live ticker cards, and build investment communities within xCube without switching to external platforms like Discord or WhatsApp.
epic.businessValue: Reduces the 6–8 minute context-switch gap to external chat tools, targeting an 18% increase in trade conversion from peer discussions. Users who engage in in-app chat are 3.4× more likely to remain active after 30 days.
epic.prdLink: PRD: In-App Messaging & Trade Chat — xCube

features.title: Channel Management
features.description: Users can create, join, and leave topic-based trading channels with configurable public or private membership. Channel organisation is how traders self-select into relevant communities (by ticker, sector, or strategy), which directly drives the retention metric the initiative is targeting. A messaging transport without addressable channels has no product value — users cannot find relevant conversations.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create a channel with a name, topic description, and privacy setting (public or private) in under 3 taps
Channel creators can invite members to private channels via a uniquely generated shareable link that expires after 48 hours
Users can leave a channel at any time; the system removes them from future message delivery within 1 second of confirmation
A public channel directory is searchable by channel name and topic tag with results returning in under 300ms

userJourneys: Journey 1: Join a topic channel and discuss a ticker

features.title: Real-time Text Messaging
features.description: Users can send and receive text messages in topic-based channels with sub-500ms delivery during market hours. This is the foundational interaction that eliminates the need to leave xCube for Discord or WhatsApp — the core hypothesis to validate before investing in enrichment features. Without reliable, low-latency delivery, every downstream feature in this initiative is worthless.
acceptanceCriteria: Messages are delivered to all channel members within 500ms at p99 during market hours (NFR2 — Performance)
Messages persist and are retrievable across devices for 7 years with cryptographic integrity verification (NFR5 — Data Retention)
Offline messages are queued and delivered automatically when the user reconnects within the same session
Message send failures surface a user-visible error with a manual retry option within 3 seconds of failure detection

userJourneys: Journey 3: Send a message in a channel

features.title: Live Ticker Card Sharing
features.description: Users can embed a live-updating stock ticker price card directly into any message; recipients can tap the card to navigate to the instrument detail screen with a pre-filled buy order. This is the feature that closes the loop from social discussion to trade execution — the primary conversion mechanism underpinning the 18% trade conversion hypothesis. It cannot ship in MVP because it requires stable message delivery and real channel membership data to validate card engagement rates.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can attach a ticker card to a message from any instrument detail screen via a 'Share to Chat' button without leaving the instrument view
Ticker cards render current price and percentage change within 200ms of message open at p95 (NFR2 — Performance)
Tapping a ticker card navigates the recipient directly to the instrument detail screen with a pre-filled buy order at the card's displayed price
Cards display live price updates during market hours without requiring a manual message refresh or re-open

userJourneys: Journey 2: Share a live ticker card in a message

features.title: Push Notifications for Channel Activity
features.description: Users receive push notifications for new messages in joined channels when the app is backgrounded, with per-channel muting controls. Notifications close the re-engagement loop — without them, users must actively return to xCube to discover new messages, which is the primary drop-off point identified in the retention analysis. Phase 1 is the correct slot because notification reliability depends on stable message delivery from MVP.
acceptanceCriteria: Push notifications are delivered within 2 seconds of message send at p95 (NFR2 — Performance)
Users can mute notifications independently per channel without leaving the channel or losing membership
Tapping a notification deep-links the user directly to the correct channel and the specific message that triggered the notification
Notification payload includes sender display name, channel name, and a 100-character message preview truncated with ellipsis

userJourneys: Journey 1: Join a topic channel and discuss a ticker

features.title: Content Moderation
features.description: The system automatically flags messages containing hate speech or pump-and-dump signals for human moderator review within 1 second of send, with a graduated enforcement policy for repeat offenders. Without moderation, regulatory exposure and community quality degradation will erode the retention gains from core messaging — FCA and SEC guidelines require timely review of flagged financial promotion signals. Phase 1 is the right slot because MVP needs real message volume to tune detection thresholds before automated enforcement is reliable.
acceptanceCriteria: Messages containing hate speech or identifiable pump-and-dump patterns are auto-flagged within 1 second of send and quarantined from public view (NFR4 — Compliance)
Flagged messages are assigned to a human moderator review queue with a target 24-hour SLA for first review
Users accumulating 3 confirmed violations within a rolling 30-day window receive a graduated response: written warning, then 7-day suspension, then permanent ban
Moderators can overturn false-positive flags and restore messages; false-positive rate is logged and reported weekly to the Trust & Safety team
